scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hemocase/shared && concurrently -k -n SERVER,WEB -c red,cyan "npm run dev -w @hemocase/server" "npm run dev -w @hemocase/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hemocase/shared && npm run build -w @hemocase/web && npm run build -w @hemocase/server
scripts.game: npm run build && npm run start -w @hemocase/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hemocase/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
